hypothesis: A fall in use of mature low-LBD learned clauses as direct implication reasons (not merely total clause reuse) can identify when changing restartint=50 at conflict >=2048 is beneficial.

measurement.birth: Do not change Kissat clause layout. When a learned nonbinary redundant clause is created, record (128-bit order-insensitive clause-content signature, creation conflict) in a sidecar hash map. At implication/analysis use, retrieve birth by same content signature. Age is conservatively 0 if contents changed / signature absent; identical-content duplicates overwrite with latest birth. Approximate per-structure age, not absolute per-object identity.
measurement.lbd: clause.glue read before any possible promotion; low LBD <=4
measurement.implication_role: kissat_assign_reference reason redundant clauses in assign.c; includes post-learning asserting UIP assignments, which is tracked transparently
measurement.conflict_role: deduce.c mark_clause_as_used: conflict clause vs antecedent reason in 1-UIP conflict analysis
measurement.age: Conservative born-since-content-signature age in conflicts; may be unknown for shrunk/replaced clauses, and identical-content duplicate clauses get latest birth. Only large learned clauses (>2 literals).
measurement.checkpoints: actual conflict counters near 256/512/1024 (may overshoot), use actual intervals and their cumulative counts
measurement.limitation: 128-bit content-signature birth ledger approximates original age only while clause literal contents remain unchanged. Logged missing-age uses. No changes to native clause object size or memory ABI. All same-binary controls pay sidecar overhead, original/production solvers untouched.

frozen_gate.definition: P = (old_low_LBD_direct_implications_512 - old_low_LBD_direct_implications_256)/(1 + all_redundant_direct_implications_512 - all_redundant_direct_implications_256), Q analogous for 512→1024. Trigger if n>=220 and P>=0.08 and Q<0.85*P.
frozen_gate.inverse_control: r21_inverse50 triggers when same eligible n>=220 and the rule is false; no change to learned database.
